about: Types a Snapshot does not read (ADR-0065), each refused naming its column and the type as Arrow's own tools print it: lists, structs, maps, binary, durations, intervals, float16, null, a dictionary of anything but text, and a timestamp in a zone other than UTC. Transcribed from ExGrid.Data.Arrow.Tests' RefusalTests.

cases.name: ADR-0065: a timestamp in Asia/Tokyo, a zone other than UTC, is refused naming the column and the zone

refused.message: Column 'When': the Arrow type timestamp[us, tz=Asia/Tokyo] is a timestamp in the time zone 'Asia/Tokyo', which a Snapshot does not read: converting it would need a time zone database. Write it in UTC, or as clock values without a time zone.
